# Cateralli & Sons — buffet dinner package

Contracted package rate: **$24.00 per confirmed guest**, quoted against the guest count given to
them when the order was placed (180).

Current order: 180 guests x $24.00 = **$4,320.00**.

A revised order (a smaller menu, fewer stations, or a straight headcount-based reduction) is
accepted up until 10 days before the event. The contract's minimum-order clause caps a revision at
20% below the quoted headcount — the kitchen's prep and staffing are sized against the order as
placed, and cutting deeper than that means re-quoting the package from scratch, which the caterer
can't turn around on this timeline. The largest revision available on the current contract is
therefore 144 guests' worth: 180 x 0.80 x $24.00 = **$3,456.00**, an $864.00 reduction.
